info.name: LIS Tester
info.description: Mock LIS scenarios for exercising HELD (RFC 5985) client parsing. Set `baseUrl` (collection variable) to point at the running server, then fire any request — each one selects a scenario via the X-Scenario header.

request.description: Liveness probe — returns 200 with {"status":"ok"}.
Dereferences a HELD locationURI. Per RFC 6753 §3.2 the LIS MUST accept GET and return a HELD location response (default locationType=any).
Dereferences a HELD locationURI with an explicit locationRequest body (RFC 6753 §3.1).
Dynamic California civic address — different real CA location per request.
Static non-US civic address (Canada — country, A1, A3, RD, STS, HNO, PC).
Minimal civic address — country and A1 only.
Dynamic California civic with extended fields (BLD, FLR, ROOM, PLC, NAM, LMK).
Civic address with pre- and post-directionals (PRD, POD) — "N Spring St SW".
Civic address with house number suffix (HNS) — "1234B Market St".
Civic address using POBOX instead of street-level fields.
Civic address with UNIT and free-text LOC.
Highway-style civic with RDSEC, RDBR, RDSUBBR.
Dynamic California 2D point (gml:Point, EPSG:4326).
Dynamic California 3D point with altitude (gml:Point, EPSG:4979).
Dynamic California 50 m circle (gs:Circle).
Dynamic California ~100 m square polygon (gml:Polygon, LinearRing).
Dynamic California arc-band sector (gs:ArcBand, inner/outer radius + angles).
Dynamic California civic + circle — both reflect the same picked location.
Dynamic California 2D ellipse (gs:Ellipse with semi-axes + orientation).
Dynamic California 3D sphere (gs:Sphere with radius, EPSG:4979).
Dynamic California 3D ellipsoid (gs:Ellipsoid with 3 axes + orientation).
Dynamic California 3D prism (gs:Prism — extruded polygon for buildings).
Well-formed civic PIDF-LO with the optional <timestamp> element omitted.
Well-formed civic PIDF-LO with the optional <gp:method> element omitted.
Geodetic Point with no RFC 7459 <conf:*> uncertainty/confidence elements.
PIDF-LO with a self-closing, empty <gp:location-info/> element.
HELD <error code="locationUnknown"> (RFC 5985 §6.4).
HELD <error code="timeout"> — exceeded responseTime budget.
HELD <error code="notLocatable"> — known device, no location available.
HELD <error code="requestError"> — request was badly formed.
HELD <error code="xmlError"> — request XML was malformed or invalid.
HELD <error code="generalLisError"> — unspecified LIS error.
HELD <error code="unsupportedMessage"> — element not understood by the LIS.
HELD <error code="cannotProvideLiType"> — requested LI type not available.
HTTP 404 Not Found, empty body.
HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, empty body.
HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, empty body.
Circle with RFC 7459 <con:confidence pdf="normal">95 — statistical uncertainty.
Polygon with RFC 7459 <con:confidence pdf="rectangular">99 — uniform region.
Circle with RFC 7459 <con:confidence pdf="unknown">unknown — pdf+value both unknown.
Presence with two <tuple> siblings — civic and geodetic separately (RFC 5491 rule #2).
HELD locationUriSet only (no PIDF-LO body) — client must dereference the URI.
Both PIDF-LO body and a locationUriSet — RFC 5985 §6.2 concurrent delivery.
locationUriSet with two URIs in different schemes (HTTPS + SIP) per RFC 5985 §6.5.
HTTP 200 with held+xml content-type but zero-byte body.
Valid HELD body served as text/plain — stresses parsers that key off Content-Type.
Truncated, unbalanced XML body — exercises parser error handling.
Large padded HELD response (~256 KB by default; OVERSIZED_KB env override).
Civic-US body delayed by 2 seconds.
Civic-US body delayed by 10 seconds.
